newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator falls 7 cents to 696c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator falls 7 cents to 696c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator dropped seven cents to 696 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece all lost ground, with 19/20 micron up to one percent cheaper, 21/23/24m up to 1.5 percent cheaper, 22m two percent cheaper, 25m slightly cheaper and 26m 0.5 percent cheaper.
Merino skirtings of 19/20/21m were up to one percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/28/29m were unchanged, 30m 0.5 percent cheaper and 31m slightly dearer.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged and locks and crutchings firm.
WI said Japanese interests and China were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 23,265 bales offered, 11.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney and Melbourne with about 26,840 bales to be offered.
